description: This file contains utility functions for the Home module of vtiger CRM, including functions to retrieve upcoming and pending activities, process activity entries, and get user-specific layout settings.

methods.name: homepage_getUpcomingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming activities for today, limited by maxval, and optionally returns count if calCnt is 'calculateCnt'.

methods.name: getActivityEntries
methods.description: Formats an array of activity details into a display-ready array with links and styling based on priority and type.

methods.name: homepage_getPendingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves pending activities for today, limited by maxval, similar to upcoming activities, with optional count return.

methods.name: getNumberOfColumns
methods.description: Returns the number of layout columns for the current user, defaulting to 4 if not set.
